title: observability: token-level KV logging + metrics dashboard + alert tuning
author: Aisha Rahman
release_notes: Enhances token-level KV logging, adds new Grafana panels for KV hit/miss cost and latency, updates Prometheus alert thresholds for KV cache regressions, and improves tracing spans for cache lookup paths.
body: Summary: This PR instruments token-level KV cache operations with richer logs, metrics, and traces; adds Grafana dashboard panels showing token-level cost and latency breakdowns for KV hits/misses; and tunes Prometheus alerting to reduce noise while catching regressions. Motivation: customers rely on KV cache efficiency to keep token costs down and preserve latency SLOs. Recent incidents (linear ENG-2134) showed missing observability around partial KV misses and degraded tail latency. This change provides the missing signals and improves alert precision to avoid pager fatigue. What I changed: 1) Metrics: added prometheus counters and histograms: redwood_kv_cache_lookup_total{result="hit|miss|partial"}, redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio_gauge, redwood_kv_cache_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket (optimized buckets for sub-ms to 100ms), and redwood_token_level_cost_per_request gauge tagged by model, route, and customer_tier. 2) Logging: enriched KV lookup logs with stable keys: request_id, trace_id, model, route, seq_len, kv_result, kv_latency_ms, kv_bytes_saved, and cost_estimate_tokens. Logs are structured JSON and gated behind a config flag (obs.kv_verbose) to avoid high-cardinality by default. 3) Tracing: new spans for kv.lookup and kv.apply with attributes for hit/miss/partial and kv_latency_ms; sampling updated for long-tail traces (>50ms). 4) Dashboards: new Grafana panels under Observability -> KV Cache -> Token-level Cost & Latency showing: token cost breakdown (prefix cache savings vs compute), 95/99 percentile latency for kv lookup and overall token generation, KV hit ratio heatmap by model+route, and per-customer token-cost trend chart. Panels include links to example traces and underlying PromQL. 5) Alerts: tuned existing alerts to reduce noise: KVCacheMissRateHigh (fired when sustained miss rate > 8% for 10m with accompanying increased token_cost or token_latency), KVLookupLatencyTail (95th > 30ms for 5m and request_rate > baseline), and TokenCostRegression (detects >10% increase in cost per 1M tokens over 1h compared to rolling baseline). 6) Tests & CI: added unit tests for metric labeling, integration tests for dashboard panel queries (synthetic metrics), and e2e smoke test for logging format. 7) Docs: updated observability runbook and dashboard README with how to interpret KV token-level panels and runbooks for alert triage. Rollout plan: feature is behind a feature flag (obs.kv_verbose) and dashboard panels are added as opt-in; alerts are deployed to staging first for 48h before production. Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive, logging default remains low-cardinality. Related: references ENG-2134 (incident), ENG-1987 (dashboard request).

Enrich KV lookup logs with structured fields and feature flag (Aisha Rahman)

Grafana: add token-level cost & latency panels and dashboard JSON (Maya Patel)
Prometheus: add alert rules and tuned thresholds, include runbook links (Diego Morales)

review_comments: Diego Morales: Can we avoid high-cardinality labels on token-level metrics? Suggest gating detailed token tags behind a config flag and provide aggregated fallback. -- addressed in commit 'Add feature flag and aggregated metrics'.
Connor Lee: Tracing spans look good, but please ensure span duration is recorded in microseconds for precision. -- updated in cache_tracing.go to record micros.
Maya Patel: Dashboard panels are informative; can we add links from the panel to sample traces and an example log line? -- added deep-links and example query snippets in dashboard JSON.

SRE (Charlie Nguyen): Alert thresholds look reasonable but reduce sensitivity during low traffic windows. Suggest coupling with request_rate condition. -- KVLookupLatencyTail updated to include request_rate check.
Aisha Rahman (author): Thanks for review feedback; updated PR to add config gating, sampling rule, and alert rate conditions. Will monitor staging for 48h before prod rollout.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (dashboard queries run against synthetic metrics)
notes_for_operators: After deploy enable obs.kv_verbose in canary for 24h and validate dashboard panels show expected KV hit/miss distribution. If TokenCostRegression fires, check KV hit ratio and recent rollout or model changes. Runbook kv_miss_rate.md contains triage steps and recommended mitigations (increase cache size, adjust routing to smaller seq_len, roll back recent model quantization changes).
